project_type: Flask REST API backend + React (Vite) frontend
build_system: pip for backend, npm + Vite for frontend
test_framework: pytest for backend (165 tests), no frontend test framework found
build_command: Backend: python -m pytest (runs tests); Frontend: npm run build (production build check)
verification_instructions: Backend: cd routeOptimiserBackend && python -m pytest. Frontend: cd routeOptimiserFrontend && npm run build. For corpus: start backend with python main.py, query corpus endpoint and verify 1000 docs.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that need to be checked in for this task
environment_constraints: Backend runs on port 5001 by default. IR engine builds index at startup from corpus.build_corpus(). Frontend must have VITE_API_BASE_URL set to backend URL.
contribution_requirements: Run pytest before submitting. README.md instructs: 'Please run python -m pytest and npm run build before submitting.'
key_patterns: Backend: Flask blueprints in src/api/, data classes with dataclass decorator in src/ir/schemas.py, corpus functions return list[IRDocument]. Frontend: Tailwind CSS classes, useState hooks, API_BASE_URL constant from src/api/client.js, Badge component reused across views.
